meta.name: angular-architect
meta.description: Generates Angular 17+ standalone components, configures advanced routing with lazy loading and guards, implements NgRx state management, applies RxJS patterns, and optimizes bundle performance. Use when building Angular 17+ applications with standalone components or signals, setting up NgRx stores, establishing RxJS reactive patterns, performance tuning, or writing Angular tests for enterprise apps.

copy.tagline: 构建 Angular 17+ 企业级应用，优化路由与状态管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Angular 17+ 开发大型应用，需要高效的路由、状态管理和测试方案。
copy.tagline_en: Build Angular 17+ enterprise apps with optimized routing and state management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building large Angular 17+ applications and need efficient routing, state management, and testing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成 Angular 17+ 的独立组件、配置带懒加载和守卫的路由、实现 NgRx 状态管理、应用 RxJS 模式，并优化打包性能。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 Angular 17+ 应用、设置 NgRx 状态、编写 RxJS 响应式代码、进行性能优化或编写企业级 Angular 测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Angular 17 独立组件，使用 OnPush 和信号。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合规范的组件代码。

say.text: 为我的 Angular 应用配置带懒加载的路由和守卫。
say.note: Claude 会生成路由配置和守卫代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates Angular 17+ standalone components, configures advanced routing with lazy loading and guards, implements NgRx state management, applies RxJS patterns, and optimizes bundle performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build Angular 17+ apps, set up NgRx stores, write RxJS reactive patterns, performance tune, or write Angular tests for enterprise apps.

say_en.text: Create an Angular 17 standalone component with OnPush and signals.
say_en.note: Claude will generate compliant component code.

say_en.text: Configure routing with lazy loading and guards for my Angular app.
say_en.note: Claude will generate route config and guard code.

say_en.text: Set up NgRx store with actions, reducers, and selectors.
say_en.note: Claude will generate state management files.
